body:
A very unique feeling! I mixed the three up pretty well, so instead of getting a hit of just one or two of em, I can experience all three at the same time. I can feel the weed starting to slow things down, the salvia grounding me, and the lightness of the tobacco smoke. After the nicotine calm wears off, and then the weight of the salvia is lifted, I am left with a nice high :)
happy smoking
